items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection. Adobe released a fix on October 13, 2026, but a manual patch is required, and new installs remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability discovered by Sansec, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks were observed starting September 4th, 2026, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 21, 2026.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover and other vulnerabilities
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover.

items.title: Incorrect authorization vulnerability (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. This was part of the APSB26-92 update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes that allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce that allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass security measures and maintain unauthorized access. Adobe published this issue in security bulletin APSB25-94.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) requiring authentication
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges, and was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) requiring administrator privileges
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges, and was addressed in APSB26-92.
